name: Vanyola (Hungary)
description: Three equal vertical stripes of blue, light grey and blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Vanyola: a blue and white shield with a church, a bird and a snake, below a scroll inscribed VANYOLA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
